# httpkit

```go
import "goliath/pkg/httpkit"
```

Package httpkit collects net/http presets for building services: ready\-made handlers and the shared conventions they rely on. It has no third\-party dependencies.

The handlers live in subpackages:

- handlers/healthcheck serves health, liveness, and readiness endpoints.
- handlers/stdwrapper adapts application handlers to a standard request/response contract \(request ID, response envelope, error\-code header, logging, panic recovery\).

This package re\-exports the standard header names those handlers use so callers can reference them without importing a specific handler subpackage. They are grouped under the Headers namespace:

```
req.Header.Get(httpkit.Headers.RequestID)
resp.Header.Get(httpkit.Headers.ErrorCode)
```

## Variables

<a name="Headers"></a>Headers holds the standard HTTP header names used by httpkit's handlers. Reference a field rather than hardcoding the string, e.g. httpkit.Headers.RequestID.

```go
var Headers = headerNames{
    RequestID: stdwrapper.HeaderRequestID,
    ErrorCode: stdwrapper.HeaderErrorCode,
}
```
